uncertain: Continuation page: title, artist, and 1= are not printed here.
Fm, C/E, and Am shapes are the printed dots shifted one row onto the nut (they land on 133111, 032010, and x02210). Other chord diagrams were not fret-read, so those marks have no shape.
Tab keeps the opening multi-string x column of each first-system bar; the rest of the x grid is stems mixed with strums and was not copied string-by-string.
Some lyric syllables are placed by the printed phrase rather than a measured x, especially 银色满际, 沉溺, and 拥有你.
